name: Jausenstation Goingstätt
beschreibung: The Jausenstation Goingstätt is a traditional inn in the municipality of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser. The building sits on a sun terrace above the Söllerboden and offers views of the Kaisergebirge. The dining room is rustic and alpine in style. The menu focuses on the classic Tiroler Jause. Typical dishes are the Brettljause with various types of cheese and sausage as well as the Kaiserschmarrn. The ingredients come predominantly from the region. The establishment is a popular resting place for ski tourers and mountain bikers. Guests can expect simple, down-to-earth hospitality here.
